name: National Palace of Culture
description: A huge congress and concert center opened in 1981 for the 1,300th anniversary of the Bulgarian state.

name: Sveta Nedelya Cathedral
description: An Orthodox cathedral on a central square, rebuilt after a bomb attack in 1925 killed more than 150 people inside.

name: Former Communist Party House
description: The former headquarters of the Bulgarian Communist Party, a large Stalinist building on the Largo, now used by parliament.

name: Ancient Serdica
description: Excavated streets and buildings of Serdica, the Roman city under Sofia, shown in the open beside a metro station.

name: National Assembly building
description: The neo-Renaissance parliament building from the 1880s, facing a statue of the Russian tsar whose war freed Bulgaria in 1878.

name: Bulgarian National Radio
description: The headquarters of the country’s public radio broadcaster, with studios and a concert hall.
